jets.name: jets
jets.definition: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5], bjets = [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]

bjets.name: bjets
bjets.definition: [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5], light_jets_sorted = sort_by_pt([j for j in jets if j not in bjets])
